placeName.zh-CN: 留尼汪岛圣皮埃尔至圣但尼

courseChanges.from: Colorado 下降段按原线下行
courseChanges.to: 该段因气旋 Garance 后封闭，改经 Piton Trésor–Rampes de la Montagne–Chemin des Perles–Vigie；CP20 Colorado 171.6 km，终点 La Redoute 178.6 km

note.zh-CN: 改线。官方 2025 赛道说明明示 Colorado 段自气旋 Garance 后封闭，并逐段点名替代路径；属赛道变化，不是关门或组别规则调整。
note.en: Course change. The official 2025 course description states the Colorado section has been closed since cyclone Garance and names the replacement route; this is a course change, not a cut-off or group rule change.

details.distanceMethod: Multiple official bases: the 2026 race page lists 180 km; the 2026 official cut-off table totals 180.8 km; the English race overview lists 170 km; the archived 2013 rules give about 165 km. Figures are shown side by side and not averaged.
details.elevationMethod: Multiple official bases: the 2026 race page lists 10,200 m D+; the 2026 official cut-off table gives +10,191 m and −10,154 m; the English race overview lists 10,500 m; the archived 2013 rules give about 9,900 m. Figures are shown side by side and not averaged.
